description: This bar chart, titled “Targets,” illustrates the number of datasets published each year from 2012 to 2022, categorized by whether the datasets focus on “Untargeted” (blue bars) or “Targeted” (orange bars) hate speech. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled “Year,” and the vertical axis represents the “Number of datasets,” scaled linearly from 0 to 160. The chart uses grouped bars for each year, with the blue portion indicating the count of untargeted datasets and the orange portion indicating the count of targeted datasets; the total height of each bar corresponds to the total number of datasets for that year. The bars are sorted in ascending order by year, from left to right. In most years, the orange portion is taller than the blue portion, indicating more targeted datasets than untargeted datasets. The values for each bar are approximate, but the chart provides exact data points: in 2012, there were 0 untargeted and 0 targeted datasets; in 2013, 0 untargeted and 1 targeted; in 2014, 0 untargeted and 1 targeted; in 2015, 0 untargeted and 1 targeted; in 2016, 1 untargeted and 5 targeted; in 2017, 5 untargeted and 15 targeted; in 2018, 10 untargeted and 30 targeted; in 2019, 10 untargeted and 50 targeted; in 2020, 40 untargeted and 80 targeted; in 2021, 60 untargeted and 100 targeted; and in 2022, 10 untargeted and 30 targeted. The bars are not visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their standard color-coding.
